description: The file `UtilFormatOut.java` contains a utility class with static methods for various output formatting functions, including number, currency, percentage, quantity, date/time formatting, web encoding, and string handling. It helps with formatting data for JSPs and other output contexts within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: UtilFormatOut
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for output formatting, including number, currency, percentage, quantity, date/time, string encoding, and null-safe string operations.
